title: Trait bounds on struct defs instead of impls
description: WfResponse<T: Serialize> (writefreely_api.rs:50) and PaginatedResponse<T: Serialize> (funkwhale_api.rs:85) put Serialize bounds on the struct definition. Rust convention is bounds on impls, not struct defs. The current approach infects all uses: you can't store a WfResponse<MyType> in a variable, pass it to a function, or pattern-match it without MyType: Serialize, even if you never serialize it. Should be: struct WfResponse<T> { ... } with impl<T: Serialize> Serialize for WfResponse<T>. Also, WfResponse derives Serialize but not Deserialize, while WfError derives only Serialize -- asymmetric for a wire type.
close_reason: Fixed: Serialize bound removed from WfResponse<T> and PaginatedResponse<T> struct defs
